empirical_windows_behavior: Dequeues Bluetooth device and adapter notifications (WINEBLUETOOTH_EVENT_ADAPTER_ADDED, WINEBLUETOOTH_EVENT_DEVICE_ADDED).
Supplies device address (BTH_ADDR), name, class of device, and RSSI to winebth WDM PDO enumerator.
macos_backend_strategy: Pump events from IOBluetoothDevice recent/paired list and IOBluetoothDeviceInquiry.

sources: Apple Developer IOBluetoothDevice notifications and inquiry documentation
